content.title: GoDaddy raises 2025 revenue forecast on AI-driven demand
content.summary: GoDaddy has been rolling out AI features to gain traction for its services, which help businesses set up online domains, payment systems and expand their online presence.  For the year, GoDaddy raised its revenue expectations to a range of $4.93 billion to $4.95 billion, up from a prior sales forecast of sales between $4.89 billion and $4.94 billion.  The company launched GoDaddy Airo in 2024, an AI-powered tool to design and build a business' online presence.
